shared_elements: row of repeated similar figures facing the same direction
horizontal registers stacked one above another
low-relief figures set against a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces organise profile figures into stacked horizontal registers separated by dividing bands, with at least one register consisting of a row of repeated creatures facing the same way — a generic compositional convention rather than a distinctive shared motif. The depicted content diverges sharply: A shows an animal repertoire (quadrupeds, a descending predator, birds and serpentine forms) with an isolated small anthropomorph, while B shows ranks of clothed human figures in procession carrying staffs, bordered by rosette friezes, and is rendered with far more anatomical and costume detail.
